content: The experimental results show that our multimodal approach outperforms the GARCH(1,1) volatility model, which is the most prevalent econometric model for daily volatility predictions. The outperformance being sector-wise and demonstrates the effectiveness of combining price and news for short-term volatility forecasting. The fact that we outperform GARCH(1,1) for all analyzed sectors confirms the robustness of our proposed architecture and evidences that our global model approach generalizes well.
